description: Needs an Alion account or an x402 payment (not free on this open address). One investor in full - for a fundraising shortlist, a co-investor check or due diligence on a fund: everything search_investors returns (type, office, sectors, stages and countries of the portfolio with their shares, counts, activity, the freshest rounds of the portfolio with the role it played, a claimed fund's thesis, cheque and pitch address) plus its own description, the portfolio's venture rounds by month for a year, ten co-investors with the companies they share, eight similar investors, and the private startups of its portfolio with the most open roles. Name it by Alion id, domain ("a16z.com"), url or name; a name that matches a namesake company which is no investor falls to the candidate that is. Its portfolio is search_companies with investor=<id>, the open roles across it search_jobs. Priced like a company profile with three slices. Docs: https://alion.io/developers/docs
